projectDescription: a cozy game where you deliver bread at dawn

decisions.title: The fantasy in one line

options.A: Deliver warm bread across a sleepy hill town before the sun is up
options.B: Bake through the night, then race your loaves out before they go cold
options.C: You're the baker's dog, carrying one loaf at a time to the people who love you
options.D: Each dawn, deliver bread and watch the town wake up, one window at a time

decisions.caseAgainst: C has more instant charm; A bets on pushing being fun before the toy exists.
decisions.reasoning: Dry run: auto-picked the recommendation to walk the road.

decisions.title: Three pillars

options.A: Cozy, never rushed · Hills are the puzzle · The town wakes as you go
options.B: Warm bread, cold morning · Every house is a person · Tiny town, big routes
options.C: One more delivery · Pushing feels good · Nobody's in a hurry but you
options.D: Small and handmade · Kindness is the reward · Dawn is the clock

decisions.caseAgainst: Nothing in A protects how the cart feels; C does.

decisions.title: Toy, loop or story, and the core verb
